messages.subject: Changing the span of a concordance from 6 to 10
parts:
Hello,

I wanted to change the span of words retrieved in a concordance of an
unannotated text file (the analysis that runs from page 127-135).

I changed all values of 6 to 10, and the output produced 10 words on
the left side but only 6 on the right side. I searched the file and
believe I changed all values of 6 to 10. Clearly there is some other
value(s) that I need to change but can't work out what value it is.

Any assistance is appreciated.

Regards

Bob
